staff_server.leave.title.description: The question when the reader leaves a form of roles, custom emoji, announcements or webhooks with changes not saved. Read by administrators.

staff_server.leave.text.defaultMessage: The changes you made here are not saved and will be lost.
staff_server.leave.text.description: Under the question before leaving a form with changes not saved. Read by administrators.

staff_server.leave.cancel.description: The button that keeps the reader on the form with changes not saved. Read by administrators.

staff_server.leave.confirm.description: The button that leaves the form, losing the changes not saved. Read by administrators.

staff_server.copied.description: Beside the button that copies a value shown once (a webhook's secret), once it is copied. Read by administrators.

staff_server.copy_failed.defaultMessage: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
staff_server.copy_failed.description: Beside the button that copies a value shown once, when the browser refused to copy it. Read by administrators.
